product: Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports
text_en: I did not authorize, initiate, or otherwise consenteither expressly or implicitlyto any application for credit with this company. Accordingly, the credit inquiry appearing on my consumer report is unauthorized. Under the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( 15 U.S.C. 1681b ), a consumer reporting agency may only furnish a consumer report to a party that has a permissible purpose. I have no knowledge of any permissible purpose that would have allowed this company to access my credit file. At no time did I provide written, verbal, or electronic authorization for this company to obtain my consumer report. Therefore, the presence of this inquiry on my credit report appears to be improper. I am requesting that this matter be investigated and that the unauthorized inquiry be removed from my credit report. If you believe this inquiry was made with a permissible purpose, please provide documentation demonstrating the basis for that access, including the date of the inquiry and the permissible purpose relied upon. If such documentation can not be produced, please delete this inquiry from my credit file and provide written confirmation once the correction has been completed. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

I am filing this complaint regarding a collection account being reported by Radius Global Solutions without proper validation, in violation of 15 U.S.C. 1692g. On XX/XX/year>, I sent a written request for debt validation via certified mail. The request was delivered and received ; however, I have not received any response or validation to date. Despite my timely request, the company has continued to report this account to credit reporting agencies, including XXXX and XXXX. This constitutes continued collection activity on an unvalidated debt. Additionally, the debt collector failed to provide the required written notice ( dunning notice ) within XXXX ( XXXX ) days of initial communication, as required under 15 U.S.C. 1692g ( a ). Because proper validation has not been provided, the accuracy and legal enforceability of this account remain unverified. Reporting an unvalidated account is a violation of both the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act ( FDCPA ) and the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( FCRA ), which requires maximum possible accuracy. I specifically requested competent evidence of the alleged debt, including documentation proving I am legally obligated. No such documentation has been provided. The continued reporting of this unverified account is causing financial harm and negatively impacting my credit profile. I am requesting the immediate deletion of this account from all credit reporting agencies and a full regulatory review of this matter.

product: Credit reporting or other personal consumer reports
text_en: I am writing to formally dispute the following information in my file. I have recently reviewed my credit report and identified items that are inaccurate, unverified, and do not reflect my true financial history. Pursuant to 15 U.S. Code 1681e ( b ), your agency is required to follow reasonable procedures to assure maximum possible accuracy. The reporting of the items listed below indicates a failure in these procedures.

On XX/XX/year>, a {$250.00} charge from XXXX HOUSE XXXX in XXXX XXXX, TX appeared on my account that I did not authorize. This charge occurred during the same time period as other fraudulent transactions on my account, including a separate charge from XXXX that was investigated and refunded by Wells Fargo. While Wells Fargo confirmed and resolved the other fraudulent charges, this {$250.00} transaction was not handled consistently and remains unresolved. I have contacted Wells Fargo and opened disputes regarding this charge XXXX separate times, but it has still not been properly investigated or refunded. This credit card account is part of a Bilt rewards card that I have been trying to close, but I have been unable to do so because this unresolved fraudulent charge remains on the account. I am continuing to be charged interest on this unauthorized transaction, which is causing ongoing financial harm. I did not authorize this transaction, have no relationship with this merchant, and it appears to be part of the same fraud incident as the other charges that were already confirmed. I am requesting that this charge be treated as fraud, refunded, any associated interest charges reversed, and that I be allowed to close the account.

I am filing a complaint against XXXX XXXX regarding an account freeze and restricted access to my funds. My account was locked immediately after receiving a legitimate XXXX payment from my employer. I have already gone in person to verify my identity and provided my Social Security card, identification, birth certificate, and bank statements. Despite fully verifying my identity, my account remains restricted and I have not been given a clear explanation, resolution timeline, or specific reason for the continued hold. This situation is causing financial hardship as I am unable to access my money. I am requesting that XXXX XXXX either immediately release my funds or provide a clear, documented reason for the continued restriction along with a defined resolution timeline. I have made multiple attempts to resolve this directly with the bank without success. I am requesting immediate assistance in resolving this matter.

On XXXX XXXX, 2026, at approximately XXXX AM, Halsted Financial, a debt collection agency, unlawfully disclosed my personal and debt information to a third party with whom I have no legal or financial relationship. Halsted Financial contacted my daughters father, XXXX XXXX, and sent him a text message containing detailed information about my debt, including the creditor name ( XXXX XXXX Bank, XXXX. ), the current creditor ( XXXX XXXX XXXX ), my home address, and the amounts allegedly owed. XXXX XXXX is not my spouse, not a codebtor, not my attorney, and was never authorized to receive any information about my account. This disclosure was not made for permissible location purposes and included specific debt details, which is prohibited under the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act ( FDCPA ). By disclosing my personal and debt information to an unauthorized third party, Halsted Financial violated my privacy rights and caused me emotional distress and embarrassment. I am requesting that this matter be investigated and that Halsted Financial be required to cease unlawful thirdparty disclosures and take corrective action.
